description: End-to-end miRNA target analysis from miRNA sequences alone: whole-transcriptome target prediction across built-in species (human, mouse, rat, sheep, goat, cow, pig, chicken) or your own transcriptome/genome, with TargetScan-style seed sites, miRanda duplex confirmation and 3'UTR-restricted scanning; TargetScan and miRanda workflows, gene annotation, GO/KEGG enrichment with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR, seed-region conservation analysis, publication-quality R/ggplot2 figures, and Cytoscape network export. Fetches miRNA sequences from public databases itself (miRBase / RNAcentral), by name or for a whole species.
